admission_correction.physical_cell_admission: Ten unique post-preparation integration states, exactly 50 charged preparation controls, and all height/tilt/WBC/support predicates pass. Public-reference task success is recorded as method performance, not required for physical cell admission.
admission_correction.why: The 0.90 body-servo failures occur after 114--170 policy-controlled task steps at an arm joint limit. All four feet remain supported and body/WBC predicates pass. This is distinct from the previously excluded uncontrollable cold-prefix cell.
admission_correction.no_replacement: The predeclared 0.90 cell and all eight public-reference failures are retained. No body gain, seed, criterion or actor was selected from outcomes.

interpretation: Physical admission does not establish that any learned method will succeed. The derated-support public-reference failures remain paired baseline evidence and may support an ours advantage only if every method receives the same cell and ours succeeds under the frozen final protocol.
